sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze yet. Preserve the current owner paths, lesser(frameSpan, loadPatchHeight) branch, derived-result tolerance, and explicit m2-to-cm2 comparison. The declared span operand is only bound and unused; prior instructions require it to be semantically accounted for without inventing span = frameSpacing. The dependency contract supplies no relationship or supported role connecting span to this calculation, so provide the missing canonical relationship/path (or other contract-supported role) and link it to the ship/member data; do not relocate either property or add an applicability boolean.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the calculation and ownership semantics before freezing: bind every declared operand, including span, and use the authoritative owner/path for each term. Replace the disconnected global hullAreaValue existence query; it can pass because of an unrelated node and does not link the hull-area factor to this ship/member. Resolve the duplicated hullAreaFactor versus selectedHullAreaFactor roles and use the contract-declared operand consistently. Validate requiredTransverseFrameShearArea as a derived result with a tolerance scaled from the expected formula result, rather than merely requiring it to be no greater than the calculated value. Then enforce shearArea >= requiredTransverseFrameShearArea with compatible units: the formula result and required area are cm2 while shearArea is m2, so convert one side explicitly. Retain the lesser(frameSpan, loadPatchHeight) branch, all formula operands, and the ship-to-structuralMember path; do not add an applicability boolean.

Add sh:minCount 1 to the nltl:hasStructuralMember property so the required ship-to-structuralMember relationship cannot be absent and let the SPARQL query pass with no bindings. Preserve the existing authoritative ownership, lesser(frameSpan, loadPatchHeight) branch, formula-result tolerance, and m2-to-cm2 comparison. Also ensure the declared span operand is semantically accounted for rather than merely bound and unused; do not add an applicability boolean.

Do not impose the unsupported equality FILTER (?span = ?spacing). The formula defines s as frame spacing, while span is a separate ship-owned term; equating them invents an additional requirement and can reject valid data. Use the authoritative operand in the formula and account for span only through a declared semantic relationship or other contract-supported role; do not silently substitute span for frameSpacing. Preserve the existing ship-to-structuralMember path, all operand bindings, lesser(frameSpan, loadPatchHeight) branch, derived-result tolerance, and explicit m2-to-cm2 conversion.

Do not freeze yet. Preserve the current owner paths, lesser(frameSpan, loadPatchHeight) branch, derived-result tolerance, and explicit m2-to-cm2 comparison. The declared span operand is only bound and unused; prior instructions require it to be semantically accounted for without inventing span = frameSpacing. The dependency contract supplies no relationship or supported role connecting span to this calculation, so provide the missing canonical relationship/path (or other contract-supported role) and link it to the ship/member data; do not relocate either property or add an applicability boolean.
